translations.logic\", 1, \"choice\", \"One of these i: logic", 1, "choice", "One of these is odd. Which digit is it?", 9, "9 is the only non-prime here.
translations.logic\", 1, \"digit\", \"You overtake th: logic", 1, "digit", "You overtake the runner in second place. What position are you in now?", 2, "You take their place — you are second.
translations.logic\", 2, \"choice\", \"Which digit is: logic", 2, "choice", "Which digit is the only one that is neither prime nor composite?", 1, "1 has exactly one divisor, so it is neither.
translations.logic\", 2, \"digit\", \"All Bloops are: logic", 2, "digit", "All Bloops are Razzies. All Razzies are Lazzies. Are all Bloops Lazzies? Answer 1 for yes, 0 for no.", 1, "Yes — the chain of inclusion is transitive.
translations.logic\", 3, \"digit\", \"How many people: logic", 3, "digit", "How many people must be in a room to guarantee two share a birth month?", 3, "Thirteen people force a repeat — the last digit is 3.
translations.logic\", 3, \"digit\", \"Minimum weighin: logic", 3, "digit", "Minimum weighings on a balance scale to find the single heavier ball among 9?", 2, "Split into threes twice.
translations.logic\", 3, \"digit\", \"Three boxes are: logic", 3, "digit", "Three boxes are labelled Apples, Oranges and Mixed. Every label is wrong. How many pieces must you draw to fix every label?", 1, "One draw from the Mixed box settles all three.
translations.logic\", 3, \"digit\", \"Two speakers: A: logic", 3, "digit", "Two speakers: A says 'B lies', B says 'A lies'. How many of them can be truthful at once?", 1, "Exactly one — never both, never neither.
translations.logic\", 4, \"digit\", \"How many weighi: logic", 4, "digit", "How many weighings are needed to order 4 balls by weight, worst case, with a balance?", 5, "Five comparisons always suffice.
translations.logic\", 4, \"digit\", \"In a 3×3 magic: logic", 4, "digit", "In a 3×3 magic square using 1–9, what is the last digit of the magic sum?", 5, "The magic sum is 15.

translations.math\", 1, \"choice\", \"Which of these: math", 1, "choice", "Which of these is a perfect square?", 4, "4 is 2². The rest are not square numbers.
translations.math\", 1, \"digit\", \"How many prime n: math", 1, "digit", "How many prime numbers are there below 10?", 4, "2, 3, 5 and 7 — four primes.
translations.math\", 2, \"choice\", \"Which digit is: math", 2, "choice", "Which digit is the only even prime number?", 2, "2 is the only even prime.
translations.math\", 2, \"digit\", \"What is the unit: math", 2, "digit", "What is the units digit of 6 × 6 × 6?", 6, "216 → 6. Six is self-replicating in its units place.
translations.math\", 3, \"digit\", \"What is the unit: math", 3, "digit", "What is the units digit of 3¹⁰⁰?", 1, "Powers of 3 cycle 3, 9, 7, 1. 100 is a multiple of 4, so it lands on 1.
translations.math\", 4, \"digit\", \"How many positiv: math", 4, "digit", "How many positive divisors does 36 have?", 9, "1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36 — nine of them.
translations.math\", 4, \"digit\", \"What is the tens: math", 4, "digit", "What is the tens digit of the smallest integer whose digits multiply to 24 and add to 10?", 4, "That number is 46. Its tens digit is 4.

translations.riddle\", 1, \"digit\", \"A farmer has 1: riddle", 1, "digit", "A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?", 9, "'All but 9' means 9 remain.
translations.riddle\", 1, \"digit\", \"Two mothers an: riddle", 1, "digit", "Two mothers and two daughters share three eggs, and each person eats one. How many people are there?", 3, "A grandmother, a mother and a daughter — three people.
translations.riddle\", 2, \"digit\", \"A brother and: riddle", 2, "digit", "A brother and sister are 4 and 8. When she is twice his age, how old is he?", 4, "The gap stays 4, so he is 4 when she is 8... they are 4 and 8 now. He stays 4 only at that instant — answer 4.
translations.riddle\", 2, \"digit\", \"How many month: riddle", 2, "digit", "How many months of the year contain the number 28 days?", 2, "Every month contains a 28th day — twelve months, last digit 2.
translations.riddle\", 2, \"digit\", \"What is the sm: riddle", 2, "digit", "What is the smallest number of colours needed to paint a map so no neighbours match on a simple 4-region ring?", 2, "A ring of regions needs only two alternating colours.
translations.riddle\", 2, \"digit\", \"You enter a da: riddle", 2, "digit", "You enter a dark room holding one match. There is a candle, an oil lamp and a fireplace. What do you light first — count the letters in the answer.", 5, "You light the MATCH first. Five letters.
translations.riddle\", 3, \"digit\", \"A rope ladder: riddle", 3, "digit", "A rope ladder hangs from a boat with 5 rungs above the water. The tide rises 60 cm and rungs are 30 cm apart. How many rungs are still above water?", 5, "The boat floats up with the tide. Still five.
translations.riddle\", 3, \"digit\", \"How many anima: riddle", 3, "digit", "How many animals of each kind did Moses take on the ark?", 0, "Moses did not build the ark — Noah did. Zero.
translations.riddle\", 3, \"digit\", \"How many times: riddle", 3, "digit", "How many times can you subtract 5 from 25?", 1, "Only once — after that it is 20, not 25.
translations.riddle\", 3, \"digit\", \"If 5 machines: riddle", 3, "digit", "If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes for 100 machines to make 100 widgets?", 5, "Each machine makes one widget in five minutes.
translations.riddle\", 4, \"digit\", \"A snail climbs: riddle", 4, "digit", "A snail climbs 3 m by day and slips 2 m by night up a 10 m well. On which day does it escape?", 8, "It nets 1 m per day, reaching 7 m after day 7, then climbs out on day 8.
translations.riddle\", 4, \"digit\", \"How many times: riddle", 4, "digit", "How many times does a clock's hour and minute hands overlap in 24 hours?", 2, "Twenty-two times, so the last digit is 2.
translations.riddle\", 4, \"digit\", \"Three light sw: riddle", 4, "digit", "Three light switches sit downstairs, one bulb upstairs. You may enter the room once. Minimum number of trips upstairs?", 1, "One trip — use warmth as the second signal.
translations.riddle\", 5, \"digit\", \"A drawer holds: riddle", 5, "digit", "A drawer holds 10 black and 10 white socks. How many must you pull blind to guarantee a matching pair?", 3, "Three socks always contain a pair.
translations.riddle\", 5, \"digit\", \"A plane crashe: riddle", 5, "digit", "A plane crashes exactly on the border of two countries. Where do you bury the survivors?", 0, "You do not bury survivors — zero.
